headline:
لعبة R.E.P.O.
تدعم العربية الآن
label: جديد
note: Primary: semiwork's Steam announcement 'R.E.P.O. v0.5.0 - The Sunstone Update' (29 Oct 13:06Z): new level Sunstone Valley Resort, new enemy, gamepad support, localization added in 21 languages; Steam store languages list Arabic among 21 (full audio English only). Steam AE price 27 AED regular (35% off at 17.55 when read 15:20Z). Sound: Monster Update trailer from 11.0 s, no speech (the Sunstone trailer is a song with burnt-in lyrics throughout, the Release trailer carries player chatter every few seconds, the Museum trailer is narrated). Pictures: Sunstone trailer's lyric-free black-and-white robot intro, Release trailer gameplay.
